purpose: Bind authoritative 2027 clinical-medicine comprehensive exam geometry without inheriting 2017-2026 scoring rules as Current truth.

owner_boundary.rule: This slot owns only the unreleased/unrecovered 2027 format identity and delta. Historical scoring remains in exam-format.json; question/answer truth remains in canonical question shards.

accepted_authority: Ministry of Education / official national graduate-admissions authority
China Graduate Admissions Information Network (CHSI) official notice/outline
official 2027 examination outline or equivalent primary rule publication
required_identity: source URL or stable document identity
content hash or equivalent stable revision identity

fidelity_validation: any explicit duration/modality rule that changes execution evidence

comparison_order: classify geometry delta before changing Runtime or Forecast
update the responsible historical/current exam-format owner only after validation
reprice score/loss/workload consequences after the geometry delta is known

review_when_geometry_changes: humanities exact-number boundary if numbering changes
Chat plan or Resume that encodes stale whole-paper geometry
downstream_invalidation.rule: Historical score observations remain historical facts but cannot authorize Current-format score extrapolation after a geometry revision unless explicitly reclassified.

fallback.late: Continue using the 2017-2026 165/300 structure only as an explicit historical planning prior; keep Current 2027 geometry UNKNOWN.
fallback.partial: Bind only verified fields. Any missing question-count/segment/points/modality field remains UNKNOWN and cannot be inferred from 2026.
fallback.second_version: Treat the newer official version as a semantic revision; rerun field delta and downstream invalidation before Current authorization.
fallback.never_arrives: Use the best accepted historical prior for planning, preserve Current-format uncertainty, and do not create a precise Current calibration band.
fallback.low_confidence_conflict: Prefer primary authority; keep conflicting field BLOCKED until resolved rather than averaging sources.

forecast_contract.before_arrival: Historical 165/300 may support broad planning/stress tests only. Current-format score calibration remains unavailable.
forecast_contract.after_arrival: Forecast may consume verified geometry and matching-format score evidence; it still cannot choose learner actions or cross-subject allocation.
